title: Page authoring profiles and inspection
summary: Optional page profiles enrich the existing SDK with deterministic page inventory, inspection, validation and create-only scaffolding without a second knowledge store.
requirements: docara.authoring.json is optional and contains no page state, versions or hashes.
Six built-in profiles expose measurable structure and a review_required semantic checklist.
Page list, inspect, validate and scaffold reuse the existing SDK and OperationResult.
No knowledge directory, knowledge lock, knowledge commands or new Mirai profile are introduced.
